decisions.reason: As a close-to-core custom hearing product that already earned its own page and remains consistent with our established capabilities, we keep this low-cost option open because the evidence so far still points to realizable value rather than failure.

Although this orthopedic shoe last is strategically more distant from our core offer, its dedicated page and fit with our digital custom-manufacturing know-how justify keeping the option open one more year while uncertainty about market traction is still high.

This post-curing unit supports our core digital production workflow and can strengthen integrated system sales, so despite limited visibility so far we keep it on the market because the option value of further learning exceeds the likely holding cost.
